title: PlunderSpell Test Method
eyebrow: Choice for the last build step · built with the page builder

short.lead: The last build step has a fresh PlunderSpell session rebuild the Wick and Ophan page using only the new tools built in this feature. You chose to run it before merging, from this branch. A brand-new cloud session can't do that, though: it installs house-rules from main when it starts, and a plugin installed partway through a session only loads in the next one. This page asks how you want the test run instead.
short.hint: Tap a step to see what it creates and what it needs from you.

You asked for it to run exactly as a new session would. Only merging first and then starting a new cloud session does that, because a new session installs from main. The sandbox session runs the same code, but with me relaying between you and the session.
